utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The repair drive is next Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, I'll bring my tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Have we figured out who's bringing the tools for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we sure that's still happening? I thought it got postponed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Postponed? When did that happen? I was counting on fixing the fence this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I think I heard something about that. What's up with it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: The repair drive? Hmm, I think I was supposed to bring something... maybe tools? Or snacks?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, I think you were on snack duty. I've got some bags of chips in my car if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I heard we're having a repair drive this weekend, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I think I heard something about that from Mrs. Chen at the grocery store. Sounds like a good idea.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm planning to bring my old toaster to see if anyone can fix it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I'm late. What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Dane! I've got a bunch of tools ready in the garage—just waiting to see who needs what.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I can help carry some of those tools to the neighbors who need them. Where should we start?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, what's the schedule for the repair drive? I like to have things planned out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I'm still ironing out the details, but I'll send you the full schedule soon! Want to help me get the word out?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure, I can help. But I'd appreciate if you could give me a rough timeline first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, did you get the car fixed?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, it's all fixed now. Just needed a new alternator.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much did that set you back?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the repair drive! Is there anything I can do to help out?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you check if the old Henderson house has any usable tools? We're still gathering supplies.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, I can do that! I know the Henderson place has been empty for years, but there might be some old tools in the garage.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa, are you ready to help with the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I'm all set! I've got the tools organized and a list of volunteers ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great to hear, Rosa! I'm glad you're so organized.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: A repair drive? Let me check what supplies we have stored.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the drive. Let me know if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do. Do you have a list of what's needed?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rey, did you hear about the repair drive happening this weekend? I heard they're collecting old appliances.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I hadn't heard. Where are they collecting them?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: At the community center parking lot, from 9 to 3 on Saturday. They're taking anything with a plug!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Faye, you mentioned a repair drive—what exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, it's for the school playground—some of the swings and the slide need patching up before the kids can use them safely again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, the playground swings and slide. Do you have a list of the specific damages?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Ira, what's this about a repair drive? I'm a bit short on time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard they're organizing a drive to fix up the old playground equipment down the street. Seems like folks are chipping in tools and time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, I can spare an hour on Saturday. Just let me know what tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, I'm all set! Do we have a plan for who's bringing what?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I'm bringing the toolbox and some spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Did we talk about that already?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, I don't think so.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh, I must be mixing it up with something else. What's the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What's this repair drive all about?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It's a community event where we fix up broken items instead of tossing them. I'll be lending out my tools for anyone who needs 'em.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds helpful. What kind of tools are you offering?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal! I'm starting to organize the repair drive for next weekend. Do you have a moment to discuss the details?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure, I'd love to help. Do we have a specific location and time set up for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I was thinking Saturday morning at the community center parking lot. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Have we thought about how we're coordinating the tools and supplies? I'd hate for us to be missing something halfway through.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, good thinking! I can start a sign-up sheet for what everyone's bringing. That way we'll know exactly what we have.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a great idea—just make sure we get it out soon so people have time to gather things.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Is that something people actually do around here?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I believe so. There's one scheduled at the community center next Saturday. Are you thinking of joining?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive at the community center? Who's organizing that?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: A repair drive, eh? Sounds like it could use some organizing. What's the plan?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'd like to help out, but I might be a bit late. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I was thinking we could start at 9 sharp, get the early birds in before it gets too hot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there's a repair drive happening. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's a community effort to fix broken household items and reduce waste. I've been gathering materials and tools for it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great! Do you need any help gathering materials or tools?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I'm sorry, I think I forgot—what's it for again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's our neighborhood tool repair event this Saturday. Folks bring in broken tools and we fix 'em up together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right, the tool repair! That sounds great. I have a rusty old saw that could use some love.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I was thinking of getting the kids involved.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. What time are you planning?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I was thinking Saturday morning, around 10. The kids can help sort and fix things.
